personal.title: Embedded Software Engineer
personal.bio:
I started in backend development, building APIs and services. I explored vulnerability research in MJSEC, a security club, and weapon-system anti-tampering at the Defense Security Lab.

At Melcon, I develop firmware for semiconductor equipment, working with schematics, UART/USART communication, and GPIO and peripheral control.

I’m growing as an embedded software engineer, focused on equipment control and interested in defense systems and drones.

projects.title: ClassBridge-BE
projects.description: Backend for a one-day class platform connecting instructors and learners, with class discovery, reservations, payments, and real-time chat.

projects.title: MSG_CTF_BACK_v1.0
projects.description: A custom CTF competition platform for individual players at MJSEC, built without CTFd. Backend maintenance for challenge, participant, and ranking services.

projects.title: MSG_CTF_BACK_v2.0
projects.description: The team-competition version of MJSEC’s custom CTF platform, supporting a shared competition experience for teams.

projects.title: LinClean-BE-fastapi
projects.description: A URL security engine that combines redirect tracing, threat databases, domain heuristics, content analysis, and AI-assisted assessment into a risk verdict.

experience.description: Develop firmware for semiconductor equipment based on hardware schematics and communication specifications. Implement UART/USART initialization and data handling, and work with GPIO and peripheral control.
Evaluated the impact of anti-tampering measures on weapon systems as part of a LIG Nex1 project. Contributed to the development of a CMMC compliance tool.
Mentored backend developers and contributed to CTF and assignment-management platforms. Conducted vulnerability research and studied web security and reverse engineering.
